title: Research: certify all-target P104 relay logical growth
body:
## Summary

Add `research/p104-relay-growth/`, an independent audit and exact logical growth certificate for Philippe Van Velzen's complete all-target P104 relay-v2 correction.

```text
1,031 dirty helper lifetimes, 104 target corrections
  dense dyadic replay of every cut
forward maximum row l1 = 70; logical inverse-transpose = 56
coefficient denominators at most 8 in both directions
```

The attained growth and denominator bounds are new. The correction construction, its 9,279 transport ranks and its unfavorable fixed-template budget belong to the predecessor. The byte-identical source word and original README are retained.

Both directions check all 1,535,121 endpoint coefficients over 1,239 independent inputs. The forward correction restores every dirty helper and gives `Y += (I-G/2) X`; its logical inverse-transpose gives `X -= (I-G/2)^T Y`. The proof explains the same chronological gate order for the dual and how the forward correction composes with the inherited channel.

These are correction-only logical bounds. Combined channel/correction growth, physical dual execution, native lowering, rounded-error propagation, scalar/address work, global hosting and all-size admission remain open. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 4, refined to `P104/relay-v2/fac9e821/all-cut-logical-growth/dense-dyadic`. Base and final fetched canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. Selection nonce, scope decision, exact pins, environment and unrun obligations are recorded in TASK.json.

The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18952164) takes the published [relay-v2 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18951795), pinned to fork commit `fac9e821d31bc199b49e8ed463074a50d1264311`. The new result supplies intermediate growth bounds and a separate endpoint/frame audit; it does not rerun the heuristic search. PR2096/2166 concern different pinned words, and PR2550 concerns a two-target complementary native dual.

Final overlap covered 785 open PRs at 15:34 UTC and 1,245 Discussion records at 15:37 UTC on 2026-10-15, with complete pagination and no warnings. The focused query found this package/claim and the original relay finding. This metadata search omits arbitrary code diffs and is not a novelty guarantee.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the published 1,031-lifetime word had an author checker and cost warning, without these intermediate logical growth bounds.
  **After:** exact dense-dyadic replay verifies every endpoint coefficient, arbitrary dirty restoration, chronological common-frame contacts, rank profile and attained growth/denominator witnesses. A separate sparse Fraction implementation reproduced the endpoints and all witnesses without importing the candidate executable, and also replayed the inherited 280-input core endpoint.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64 replay passes eight behavioral groups. Faults cover lost dirty compensation, changed coefficients and lost cleanup in both directions; frames/cuts/indices/event limits; arithmetic capacity; source/receipt corruption and output overwrite. An endpoint-preserving control raises the observed norm to 81 and denominator to 16. Equivalent binary bases and an optimized Git-free unchanged-input export pass. Ruff 0.17.1 E/F/I/B/UP diagnostics pass.
- The literal channel-plus-correction local-only moment at zero saving is `104823/60736 > 1` under the fixed 832-family, nine-stage, m=73 template. The correction overfills its remaining rank allowance by 4,935. This corroborates the predecessor's obstruction for this word/template, without excluding other relay designs.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-relay-growth
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-relay-growth/verify.py
```

Selected cold replay, physical precision and full supplier admission were not run. No human or proof-assistant review is claimed.

## Credit

Philippe Van Velzen supplies the cell-tree relay design, literal word and published checker. Retain the PR2353/2393/2445 model and the PR1972/1991/1940/1071/1125 geometry/channel lineage, credited in the package with exact consumed source pins. New work and retained inputs are Apache-2.0; existing notices are unchanged.

## Open next questions

Reduce actual merge loss and rerun the complete transport bill before native synthesis; the present word already fails its fixed-template local-only moment. Separately, insert the inherited channel at the named cut and derive combined native growth and suffix-error bounds, including private-copy lifetimes. TASK.json gives first steps and blockers.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only this opt-in research package is added. The selected record and frozen predecessor evidence are unchanged.
